_readme: The one file to edit by hand. Everything else in the README is fetched: repos from GitHub, projects from the onehublabs repo.
what_i_do: I build AI-backed software for e-commerce and product data: feed pipelines, AI field mapping and translation, marketplace integrations, and the web applications around them. Most recently I was the engineer behind supplier feeds and marketplace integrations at DeinDeal, a Swiss marketplace, where the pipeline I built translated 800,000+ products into four languages.
skills: agentic workflows that plan, call tools and act: a site monitor whose agent opens pull requests with fixes, AI field mapping that leaves a field empty when it is unsure.
model gateways with routing, retries, a circuit breaker and cost tracking; evals for mapping quality; embeddings with pgvector.
scheduled pipelines, scrapers, supplier feed sync over CSV, XML, FTP and SFTP, automated reporting, GitHub Actions.
React, Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind, GSAP scroll and SVG animation, design systems, three-language sites.
Laravel, PostgreSQL, queues, category matching, translation memory.

feedgenix.com.description: AI feed intelligence for e-commerce catalogues: AI field mapping, a translation engine, and an AI gateway with routing, retries and a circuit breaker. Mapping evals included.

onehublabs.description: onehublabs.com, my own site. Astro and GSAP, three languages, a scroll-told career story, and a GitHub terrain built from my contributions.
